summaries.summary: The extension is a legitimate usage monitor for Claude Code. It reads local transcript files (~/.claude/projects) and optionally authenticates with the Anthropic API to fetch usage limits. The static scanner flagged credential reading and network calls, but these are core features of the extension's stated purpose: reading local Claude Code credentials to authenticate with the official Anthropic API (api.anthropic.com) to retrieve usage statistics. There is no data exfiltration to third-party servers, no obfuscated code, no suspicious command execution (child_process is used only to read macOS keychain for the Claude Code token), and no malicious patterns. The code is clean and aligns with its advertised functionality.

findings.description: The extension activates on 'onStartupFinished', which is broader than necessary for a status bar widget that only becomes relevant when Claude Code is in use. However, this is a common pattern for extensions that need to monitor file changes or provide immediate status bar presence, and does not indicate malicious intent.
